premises.text: People at events often struggle to make meaningful connections.
premises.evidence_span: you've come to an amazing conference like TechCrunch Disrupt, full of brilliant and beautiful people, only to stand by the conference bar eating peanuts, wondering who you should talk to next.

premises.text: A mobile application can uncover hidden connections between people at events.
premises.evidence_span: Sonar is a mobile application that uncovers the hidden connections that you share with everyone else in this room.

premises.text: Aggregating publicly available profile data can help identify relevant connections.
premises.evidence_span: Sonar scours the web for people at this venue, then aggregates and synthesizes publicly available profile data.

premises.text: Users can receive personalized overviews of potential connections.
premises.evidence_span: Sonar gives me an instant overview of Fergus and how we're connected.
you're never more than one click away from a hyper-targeted introduction to the person you want to meet.

premises.text: Sonar enables local self-expression at events.
premises.evidence_span: Sonar is laser-focused on giving you a way to tell people here that you're here and this is what you're about.

value.text: Sonar helps users make meaningful connections at events.
value.evidence_span: to make that connection, to get that story, to get that deal.

notes: No traction metrics or external validation included.
